edition.en: Text as given on Chinese Wikisource.

basis.en: Tang dynasty poem; the author died in 762.

note.en: Li Bai was in his fifties, travelling in the south, when he wrote this. Everything that moves leaves the poem, the birds and then the cloud, and what is left is a friendship with a mountain. It may be the quietest statement of companionship Li Bai ever made.
note.zh: 李白五十多岁漫游江南时所作。会动的东西一样样离开这首诗，先是鸟，再是云，剩下的是一个人和一座山之间的友谊。这或许是李白写过的最安静的陪伴。

excerpt.orig: 相看兩不厭，只有敬亭山。
excerpt.en: We look at each other and never tire, / only I and Jingting Mountain.
excerpt.zh: 相看两不厌，只有敬亭山。
